answer: PoA assigns each agent’s reputation an exponential temporal half-life, making influence depend on sustained, honestly verified service rather than short-lived activity. A freshly spawned Sybil identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements, so splitting identities cannot bootstrap trust or pass consensus. Reciprocity-weighted, matrix-factorized scores preserve this barrier across data about vine, copper, or pigment.
